Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Does a minion trigger a "When this X Untaps" if they are untapped in the untap phase?

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
If the effect doesn't specify what untapping triggers the effect, then every untap triggers the effect regardless the phase.

edit: Misread your question, if it's untap to x to do y I think card needs to be tapped in untap phase to trigger the effect. Would be easier if you would have told what effect you're referring to.

Messages.Author: FrançoisV
Messages.Body:
> Vampiric Disease
> Type: Master
> Master.
> Put a disease counter on any vampire. Each time a vampire with a disease counter is in combat at close range with another vampire, the second vampire gets a counter as well. An afflicted vampire cannot gain blood by hunting. When an afflicted vampire untaps, he or she burns a blood or, if unable, burns the disease counter. A vampire can have only one disease counter.
>
The afflicted vampire has to get from a tapped state to an untapped state for the burn blood effect to trigger.
For example you can't force an untapped diseased vampire to burn a blood with inf Meld with the land or precognizant mobility.

As a side note, it's different from "you burn a blood to untap", because if you have no blood, you do untap (and you burn the counter)

I think it differs from effects that happen "instead of untapping" during the untap phase though. For example you would burn a counter from Riddle Phantastique even if the vampire is untapped at the start of your turn.

> FrançoisV wrote:
> The afflicted vampire has to get from a tapped state to an untapped state for the burn blood effect to trigger.

Correct. If you untap an untapped card, nothing happens -- it hasn't untapped. Therefore, Vampiric Disease doesn't trigger.

Same thing with tapped card.
